confidence_notes: Dining averages and recent menus serve as July price proxies. Cocktail and wine estimates also use local prices relative to draft beer. Lodging is modeled for advance booking in July, before local lodging tax. [Wise dining prices](https://wise.com/us/cost-of-living/italy/rome) [Numbeo menu prices](https://www.numbeo.com/restaurant-prices/in/Rome)
comparable_city_reasoning: Florence provides a qualitative lodging comparison for summer sightseeing demand and higher prices in the historic center. The estimates also account for Rome's budget lodging around Termini.
